events.summary: Policy: limit edits to a small, operationally defined set of paragraphs (max 3), only reword existing facts without adding or removing factual scope, preserve qualifiers/attribution/numbers, and use edit counts/types to detect overbroad changes.

candidate.editorial_strategy: Choose 1–3 existing body paragraphs total and produce focused replacements only for those paragraphs: preserve all facts, numbers, qualifiers and attributions exactly, clarify ambiguous wording, tighten sentence order, and avoid adding new claims or outside details. Leave all other content unchanged; ensure proposed_edit_count and edits_by_type match the replacements.
